newsitem.title: USA: Rhone-Poulenc gets EPA ok on cotton aid.
newsitem.headline: Rhone-Poulenc gets EPA ok on cotton aid.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc Ag Co said Thursday its new cotton harvest-aid product, called Finish, received regulatory approval by the Environmental Protection Agency.

Rhone-Poulenc said Finish is designed to speed up the cotton harvesting process. It contains a patented plant growth regulator that Rhone-Poulenc discovered which promotes cotton boll opening and reduces by several days the time until cotton harvest.
Rhone-Poulenc Ag is a subsidiary of Rhone-Poulenc SA, a life sciences and chemicals company.
